title-info.book-title: Tribulation of Myriad Races — Chapter 1464: Ruthless su yu (2)

section.p: Su Yu stared at Mo Duona in stupefaction. What was that fool thinking? What was that look in that fool’s eyes? Why was that fool looking at him like that?
Was the fool scared?
Was that the case?
Xing Yue was staring at Mo Duona coldly. She did not like that look in Mo Duona’s eyes. She didn’t feel any malice in those eyes, but something felt off. She greatly disliked that feeling.

Fortunately, Mo Duona did not stare at them for long. He quickly schooled his face, inhaled deeply, and said, “Su Yu, stop thinking about killing me. It will benefit you to let me leave. I do not hold any malice toward you. You won’t gain any benefits from killing me.”

Su Yu sneered, “Benefits? Do you think I can’t snatch the nine-leaf skylotus without you? What a joke. I am capable of things you can’t even imagine. Why do you think He Tu is here? How did you think those outside learned of his presence? All of this is merely a part of my plan. I did all that to sow chaos. Without me, things would have been a lot calmer in here.”
Mo Duona was not surprised. He said, “I guessed it.”
Meanwhile, Xing Yue blanked out. Holy shit!
So He Tu was here because of him? She had the urge to shout at someone. Since he could get He Tu into the mansion, why didn’t he do the same for her? When did he get involved with He Tu?
Suddenly, she felt threatened.
What was the meaning of this? Was Su Yu finding her death qi insufficient? Was he about to switch to He Tu? Was he defecting?

Xing Yue roared furiously, “Su Yu, don’t even dream of killing me! I won’t die so easily! Do you think you will have peace after making He Tu your converter? Dream on! You don’t know how treacherous He Tu is!”
Both Su Yu and Mo Duona were stunned by that sudden outburst. Mo Duona muttered, “He Tu…was a male when he was alive…”
Whatever. Since Su Yu could love across life and death, what was gender for him? Was something like gender even applicable for death spirits?

That was probably not something Su Yu cared about. One should not make the mistake of thinking that death spirits were good-looking. Death spirits were essentially rotting corpses. It didn’t matter how good-looking one was when one was alive. After becoming a death spirit, one would not be good-looking anymore.
If Su Yu could tolerate even the looks of death spirits, gender was naturally not an issue for him.
Mo Duona felt his horizons broadened by Su Yu.
Holy shit!

Not only had he witnessed Su Yu’s complicated relationship with death spirits, but he had also witnessed a jealous death sovereign in action. How scary. Mo Duona started wondering if they would kill him to silence him. He seemed to have learned of something he shouldn’t.
Mo Duona was starting to lose control of his calm. He started telling himself that he knew nothing. He saw nothing. This was simply too terrifying to know.

Finally, Su Yu understood what Xing Yue was talking about. He laughed and said, “Lord, you misunderstand me. Am I such a person? It’s a misunderstanding. He Tu is merely a tool for me. He is merely a puppet under my manipulation. Is someone so blindly arrogant worthy of being my lord? Only you, Lord Xing Yue, are worthy of being my supreme sovereign.”
Mo Duona sighed inwardly. Why? Why were they flirting in front of him?
Was Su Yu fooling the pitiful death sovereign with his sweet words?
What a scumbag.

How could he do this to the death sovereign who had sacrificed so much for him? Mo Duona couldn’t hold back anymore. He said, “Su Yu, your lord must have sacrificed a lot to travel all the way from Grandstar City to this place. She must have paid a high price to help you. Geniuses like us can be arrogant, but we can’t be ungrateful…”

Yes. He had spoken for Xing Yue. Geniuses like them were arrogant, cold, and free-spirited, but they weren’t unfeeling. How could Su Yu treat the death sovereign like this? Mo Duona found himself looking down on Su Yu. Mo Duona told himself that in the same position, he would never act like this.
“Are you crazy?”

Su Yu looked at Mo Duona speechlessly. What nonsense was that? Xing Yue was probably here to kill him, nothing else. Whatever. It wasn’t even worth explaining. It wouldn’t be a bad thing for Mo Duona to misunderstand their relationship. That way, Mo Duona would be even more scared of him.

Su Yu said, “If you want to purchase your survival, sure. Fly out and shout loudly that you’re killing all immortals today. You will take the blame for this. If you agree, I am willing to negotiate. Don’t even dream of escaping. The residence is sealed.”
Mo Duona was stunned to hear that request. He said, “I…”

Su Yu asked, “Yes? Is that too hard for you? Give me your answer. Stop wasting my time. Since you wish to work with me, you need to show your sincerity. Otherwise, forget about our cooperation. Don’t forget that I killed Zhankui for you.”

Mo Duona laughed bitterly and said, “But this will turn me into the mortal enemy of the immortals. Xuan Wuji and Dao Cheng are the top elites of their generation. They are the future pillars of the immortal race.”

Su Yu said, “If you’re not ready to make everyone your enemy, what’s the point of working with me? You only need to offend the immortals. Look at me. Look at how many enemies I have. If you lack the courage to even do this, why should I work with you? I can find better partners.”

Mo Duona sighed and said, “True. I underestimated you, Su Yu. You are more ruthless than I have imagined. You’re also stronger than I imagined. I’m being honest here. You’re a lot more incredible than I have imagined.”

“Thank you.” Su Yu said, “Go on, do it. No, just open the door and shout without stepping out. A lot of people are paying attention to this place. As for Lord Xing Yue, may I trouble you to hide for a bit? We don’t want those people to know you’re still here. Mo Duona, stop wasting time. Do it now if you really want to work with me.”
After a slight hesitation, Mo Duona inhaled and said, “Sure.”
If he had to offend the immortals, so be it.
Su Yu looked at Xing Yue and said, “Lord, kill him the moment he does anything suspicious.”
“Ok…”
Xing Yue answered instinctively before blanking out. Why did she agree to that?
Su Yu grinned and said, “Lord, I have discovered the way to leave the Death Realm without being subjected to the heavenly laws. I can tell you later.”
Xing Yue’s eyes flickered. Right, she had almost forgotten about that.
Thus, she decided to restrain her anger and snorted before saying, “I know what to do.”
“Of course you do.”

Sure enough, Xing Yue was still as easy to fool as always. Mo Duona inhaled deeply, walked to the throne, and opened the gate. Then, he stepped out of the hall. A large number of experts had gathered near the hall.
Up in the sky, a defensive barrier could be seen. That was the sign that the residence had been sealed. Several Invincibles had arrived as well. However, they couldn’t enter the residence.
When Mo Duona looked around, he exhaled in relief. Fortunately, the Invincibles of the immortals were still outside the residence.

He coldly declared, “Yang Hu, Xuan Wuji, Dao Cheng, Yin Ping, and the others of the immortal race have all been punished for daring to kill Zhankui of the devil race. If the immortals are unhappy about this, you are free to come after me.”
Countless people were alarmed.
That applied to those outside the Devote King’s residence as well. Up in the sky, Immortal King Xuan He exclaimed, “What did you say?”

Mo Duona looked up arrogantly and said, “Those people have been killed for provoking me. The ones who are still alive now will also die later. I will kill them myself. What about it, Immortal King Xuan He?”
“Bastard!”
Immortal King Xuan He was furious. At the same time, a devil king said, “Mo Duona, stop spouting nonsense. You must be Lan Tian in disguise…”
Mo Duona released the Devil Pseudo Emperor’s aura and said, “Lord Tianmaiqi, this is enough to prove who I am.”
The devil king’s expression changed. This was indeed Mo Duona. He was the only person capable of using the Devil Pseudo Emperor’s blood essence. Anyone else would die upon using it.
Damn it! It was really him. Had he gone mad?”
“Where’s Zhankui?”
“Dead. Did you not notice the phenomenon?” Mo Duona coldly said, “I did what I did. I won’t hide anything. People like me do not need to hide. I am not so shameless.”
Yes. He was throwing indirect verbal assaults toward Su Yu. He was not the type to do something like this. But this time, he was truly furious. Su Yu was too shameless.
In the sky, more Invincibles appeared. Those from the immortal race were infuriated by Mo Duona’s audacity. Those from the devil race were frowning.
Madman!
What was Mo Duona doing here?
The devil king asked, “Are Xuan Wuji and the others dead? If they’re not…”
Mo Duona entered the hall and shut the gate. It was pointless to ask him. It wasn’t like those people were in his hands.
